mapping notes: Copy the MT reference unchanged. InstrId identifies this instruction for tracking and duplicate checks.
Copy the same :20: reference to EndToEndId unless the customer gave a separate end-to-end reference. EndToEndId travels to the creditor.
Map CRED to G001 (customer credit transfer). Map CRTS, SPAY and SLEV only where the service level is agreed with the receiving bank.

MT field name: Value Date Currency Interbank Settled Amount
mapping notes: Split :32A: into date, currency and amount. Amount converts from comma decimal to decimal point. Currency becomes the Ccy attribute.

MT field name: Value Date Currency Interbank Settled Amount
mapping notes: Convert the :32A: YYMMDD date to YYYY-MM-DD. Validate against the TARGET2 calendar before release.

MT field name: Value Date Currency Interbank Settled Amount
mapping notes: Instructed amount equals the settled amount unless charges are deducted. Currency becomes the Ccy attribute.
Map :50K: or :50F: name to the structured debtor name. Use the legal account name, not a trading name, to avoid BE01.
truncation risk: Medium - name over 140 characters is truncated

mapping notes: Map the :50K: account line to the debtor IBAN. Validate IBAN check digits. Use Othr Id only where no IBAN exists.
Map :52A: BIC to the debtor agent BICFI. Validate 8 or 11 characters. Invalid BIC returns RC01.
Map :53B: or :53D: only where the sender correspondent is not the debtor agent. Do not invent a correspondent where none was given.
Map :57A: BIC to the creditor agent BICFI. Validate against the BIC directory. Invalid BIC returns RC01.
Map the :59: name lines to the structured creditor name. Join the MT lines in order and check for truncation at 70 characters in the legacy name field.
truncation risk: Medium - name over 140 characters is truncated

mapping notes: Map the :59: account line to the creditor IBAN. Validate IBAN check digits. A wrong IBAN returns AC01.
Join the four :70: lines of 35 characters into one Ustrd string up to 140 characters. Log a warning where source text is longer.
truncation risk: High - text over 140 characters is truncated

mapping notes: Map BEN OUR SHA unchanged to ChrgBr. DEBT and CRED are not valid in pacs.008 and must be converted to the agreed bearer.
Map coded :72: instructions such as /INS/ or /ACC/ only where a matching pacs.008 instruction code exists. Free text that has no target element must be logged, not silently dropped.
truncation risk: High - free text with no target element is lost

mapping notes: Map each :71F: charge to a ChrgsInf entry with Amt and the charge bearer. Keep the currency from the :71F: line.
Map :77B: regulatory codes to RgltryRptg. A missing regulatory report where the corridor requires one returns RR04.
truncation risk: Medium - codes over 35 characters are truncated

mapping notes: Copy the MT202 :20: reference unchanged to InstrId.
Map :21: to EndToEndId. Where :21: is NONREF, use NOTPROVIDED in EndToEndId.

MT field name: Value Date Currency Interbank Settled Amount
mapping notes: Split :32A: into date, currency and amount, as for MT103. Currency becomes the Ccy attribute.

MT field name: Value Date Currency Interbank Settled Amount
mapping notes: Convert the :32A: YYMMDD date to YYYY-MM-DD and validate against the TARGET2 calendar.
Map :52A: BIC to the debtor agent BICFI in pacs.009.
Map :58A: BIC to the creditor agent BICFI in pacs.009. This is the receiving bank, not the end customer.
Map :72: cover or settlement instructions to InstrForCdtrAgt. Text over 140 characters is truncated, so log a warning.
truncation risk: High - text over 140 characters is truncated

mapping notes: Map :53B: account to the debtor account only where the ordering institution holds the account at the sender correspondent.
Map :20: to the statement Id. This identifies the statement, not a single entry.
Map :25: to the statement account IBAN. Validate IBAN check digits.
Map the :28C: statement number to ElctrncSeqNb. The sequence sub-number maps to LglSeqNb where the statement is split.
Map :60F: to a Bal entry with Cd OPBD (opening booked balance). The :60F: credit or debit mark maps to CdtDbtInd, and the date maps to Dt.
Split :61: into value date, entry date, debit or credit mark, funds code, amount and reference. Amount converts from comma decimal to decimal point.
Map the :61: entry date (positions 7 to 12) to BookgDt. Where the entry date is absent, use the value date.
Map the :86: narrative to the transaction remittance information. Structured :86: subfields such as ?20 and ?21 must be parsed before mapping, or the narrative is carried as free text.
truncation risk: Medium - narrative over 140 characters is truncated

mapping notes: Map :62F: to a Bal entry with Cd CLBD (closing booked balance). Check that opening balance plus entries equals the closing balance.
Map the MT101 :20: reference to the pain.001 group header MsgId. The file reference identifies the whole instruction file.
Map :21R: to InstrId for each transaction in the file. InstrId must be unique within the file.
Convert the :30: YYMMDD date to YYYY-MM-DD. Validate against the TARGET2 calendar where the payment settles on TARGET2.
Map :32B: currency and amount to InstdAmt. Amount converts from comma decimal to decimal point, currency becomes the Ccy attribute.
Map the :50C: account to the debtor IBAN in PmtInf. Validate IBAN check digits.
Map the :59: account line to the creditor IBAN. The :59: name lines map to Cdtr Nm in the same transaction.
Map the :59: name lines to the structured creditor name. Join the lines in order and check for truncation at 140 characters.
truncation risk: Medium - name over 140 characters is truncated

mapping notes: Join the :70: lines into one Ustrd string up to 140 characters. Log a warning where source text is longer.
